data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you can create an elemental aura as a free action. When you first gain this ability, choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire-once you make this selection, it can't be changed. When you generate the elemental aura, you are surrounded by the element you chose. Anyone striking you with a melee weapon or natural attack takes 2d6+%1 points of damage of the chosen type. This aura lasts for %2 rounds. The rounds in which you manifest your elemental aura don't need to be consecutive. You can dismiss the aura as a free action.|min(10,TL/2)|TL
